turns.text: I actually skipped the coffee today. Instead, I whisked up a warm, frothy green matcha tea latte with some oat milk before heading out the door. It was exactly the kind of earthy, cozy drink I needed.

turns.text: That sounds delicious and very soothing! Did you get a chance to take a proper lunch break today, or was the clinic too hectic?

turns.text: I did get a break! I had packed up some of the leftovers from yesterday's dinner to eat at work, so I just heated that up in the breakroom. Saved me from having to go out to buy food.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move, homemade meals are always the best. How are things going with Tom? Do you two have any fun plans for the upcoming weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Things are great with Tom! We're planning to go out for some salsa dancing this Saturday. I'm really looking forward to it since we haven't gone in a couple of weeks.

turns.speaker: user
